messages.subject: Adaptation length using rjags
parts:
Hi All,

Out of curiosity, I would like to know what others, who use rjags, think about how long to run the adaptation phase prior to collecting burn-in samples.  I would guess the correct answer may be "it depends"; as in the specific model structure and data certainly influence the sampler structure (e.g., various combinations of Gibbs and M-H) constructed by JAGS and, thus, how long it takes the adaptation phase to achieve efficiency.

Cheers
Jared
